user_query: I want to organize a comic-themed party and decorate the venue with posters of Marvel characters. Can you provide me with information about a specific Marvel character? Also, recommend some famous quotes from Marvel movies to include in the party invitations.

TaskList.description: 查询特定漫威角色的详细信息（如背景、图片等）
获取漫威电影中的著名台词或引用，供派对邀请函使用
